summary: English and Portuguese first-party discovery evidenced Santarém municipal cadastral, IPTU, land-regularization, and geoprocessing custodians. Direct anonymous checks reached official municipal service pages and linked portals, but no safe public parcel ID plus geometry response was obtained. No GeoJSON sample was retained; runtime remains held.
